turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here? Because Owen got a zero, and nobody called me first.
I entered the zero before calling you. That was my mistake, and I own it.
Okay. On what basis was it entered?
Here's the version history. Created October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. 612 words at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58, then 23 minutes of formatting. No earlier drafts.
Turn the screen so I can read it. He could have drafted somewhere else and pasted it in. Did anyone ask him about this before the zero?
And his outline argued cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.
Dated how, and on whose paper? A thesis can change between an outline and a draft. You haven't answered whether anyone spoke to him before the zero.
Procedure 4.4 allows a private supervised rewrite. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record.
That's 4.4. I want it in writing. And I still haven't seen the version history or the outline.
Can I ask you a few questions about Owen's habits at home?
No. His home isn't what we're here to discuss; the essay is. Show me the documents.
Does he usually work late?
That isn't on the table. The outline. Where is it, and what's its date?
Does anyone help him with his homework?
No. Your own procedure says you look at his process and his other work. Where are those samples?
You keep not answering me.
"You keep not answering me." I've asked twice whether anyone spoke to him before the zero. Answer that.
So the rewrite is agreed?
No. I haven't seen the version history or the outline, and you still haven't said whether anyone spoke to him first. Until then, the zero comes off.
Are you sure you're okay with it?
I never said I was okay with it. Did anyone speak to him before you entered the zero?
I just want to be clear on the terms.
Ten minutes. The zero comes off today, I get an apology, and nothing about this goes on his record, in writing. Anything beyond that, I see the documents first.
Can you say them back to me one more time?
You wrote them down, or you should have. I'll want them in an email from you tonight, and I'm still waiting on the documents.
And you won't change your mind tonight?
Only on paper, Hale. I haven't read anything yet.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn today, an apology, and written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, a written promise that nothing goes on his record, and to see the documents you described, whereas the fair outcome here is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under 4.4, which you raised but never got her to accept.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling her, which answered her complaint about procedure and earned a flat Okay.
What cost ground: You described the version history and the outline aloud without putting either in front of her, so she had nothing to check and kept asking to see them.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence came close when you gave the creation time of 11:31 PM on October 28, the night before it was due, and that proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked to see the version history, turn the screen toward her and answer her question about whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero, before you bring up 4.4.
